description: This file defines the class ConditionalFormatValueObject, which represents a value object used for conditional formatting in PhpSpreadsheet. It includes properties for type, value, and cell formula, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ConditionalFormatValueObject
classes.description: A class encapsulating the type, value, and optional cell formula for conditional formatting rules.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the object with type, value, and cell formula.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the conditional format value.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the conditional format value.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value associated with the conditional format.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value associated with the conditional format.

methods.name: getCellFormula
methods.description: Returns the cell formula associated with the conditional format, if any.

methods.name: setCellFormula
methods.description: Sets the cell formula for the conditional format.
